video_title: N3on Spends 24 Hours With Dennis Schröder!

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder names Malik Beasley as the best shooter he has played with
quotes.excerpt: As a shooter though, Malik Beasley is probably the best one.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who is the best shooter you have had on your team?

text_blocks.speaker: Dennis Schröder
text_blocks.text: You had Beasley, you had Michael Porter Jr., I have seen. As a shooter though, Malik Beasley is probably the best one. He is a great player, should have been an All-Star. But as a shooter though, Malik Beasley is probably the best one.

quotes.speaker: Dennis Schröder
quotes.summary_phrase: Dennis Schröder names Kobe Bryant as his all-time favorite NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Who is your favorite NBA player other than your dad? All time? Kobe.
quotes.quote: Who is your favorite NBA player other than your dad? All time? Kobe.
